footprints.note: World px: X east, Y south (floor plan), Z up; drawn at canvas (X, Y - Z). footprint = convex hull on the floor plan. collision.mode: strip = the importer's 4 px strip along the footprint's south edge; footprint = collision.polygons (floor px) is what the player's 24x12 feet box collides with: the floor where the model's solid spans reach into [step, body] px, sides pulled in 3 px and south edges 8 px north (feet stop 4 px in front, can stand at its back edge); none = never blocks.
